input.fixture: Named inert sample revision with two holes along +X. Indexes ix=0–71, iz=0–47; L=25–150 mm, ±0.05 mm match tolerance.
input.pose: World X and Z independently in ±500 mm. Local frame +Y up, +Z front; tabletop surface local Y=0 mm.
input.vibration: One vertical base tone, 0–25 Hz, peak 0–100 µm. Added centered effective mass 0–100 kg.

output.registration: World and local origins in mm, rigid XYZW quaternion, occupied hole IDs and world coordinates, input sample ID, sample revision, run sequence.
output.vibration: Peak displacement µm, phase degrees, ratio and dB, stiffness N/m, damping N·s/m, reference-model natural and crossover frequencies in Hz. Mounted fixture inherits platform motion.

failures: Incompatible pin spacing, out-of-grid index, or wrong input schema rejected. Changing a fit parameter clears attachment.
Without a fixture the table still solves; fixture response is null. Invalid mass, amplitude or frequency rejected.
limitations: Rigid heave only; no rocking, leveling action, pressure control, table flexure, fastener load, broadband PSD, measured response or calibration. Mass beyond the baseline modeled as centered with fixed equivalent linear stiffness and damping.
